mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy cycle that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in falling FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals economic weakness that triggers market anticipation of Federal Reserve policy easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) combined with stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns on CPIAUCSL, FEDFUNDS, and their interaction, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 600 thousand units signal early-cycle economic expansion, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 600, 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) compared to baseline, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 95, 60-day forward returns are positive or not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering recessionary fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in regression of 5-day returns on the two series and their interaction, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 million dollars signal strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 350000, 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 131,000 thousand persons signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 131000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
